[moved to stan-dev]

I think we need to avoid feature creep so that we can make
progress. This turned from trying to repurpose the stan_demo()
function in RStan (or wherever it is) into a lever that Andrew
could use to motivate improvements to ADVI to a general user-facing
statement about Stan modeling, etc. Please keep in mind the holy
trinity of

(functionality, cost/time, quality).

As you increase functionality (feature creep), you almost always
either extend time or reduce quality.

It's too easy to sit in a chair or at a board and say "this feature
is easy to add, we should have that too" until we don't get
anything.

- Bob
